title: Concurrency-Informed Orchestration for Serverless Functions
note: CIDRE keep-alive/eviction policy for serverless containers evaluated against two production FaaS traces - reproducible as a trace-driven simulation; concern: no official repo found by GitHub/web search

title: AdaServe: Accelerating Multi-SLO LLM Serving with SLO-Customized Speculative Decoding
note: Multi-SLO LLM serving via speculative decoding - user-space serving system on GPU. Concern: AE artifact assumes 8x A100 and Docker with CUDA 12.4; would need scale-down to one 7-8B model plus draft model on the A5000 and a non-Docker build

title: Database Native Model Selection: Harnessing Deep Neural Networks in Database Systems
note: in-database neural model selection; single GPU is enough

title: Computation is Fast, Use Threadlet!
note: Included only because it cannot be screened out on the evidence available. TELOS lab at PKU confirms the acceptance but no abstract, preprint or artifact is public, so neither topic nor machine fit can be judged. Title suggests a lightweight thread or compute-offload abstraction which could be either user space or kernel.

title: Welder: Scheduling Deep Learning Memory Access via Tile-graph
note: Memory-access-centric DL compiler with a tile-graph abstraction; single-GPU evaluation, and the memory-bound regime it targets is exactly where a 24 GB Ampere card is representative. Concern: FP16 tensor-core paths work on Ampere but any FP8 kernel path does not, and the artifact expects a pinned CUDA/TVM stack. Merge note: scout linked the artifact branch https://github.com/microsoft/nnfusion/tree/osdi2023welder .

title: Tilus: A Tile-Level GPGPU Programming Language for Low-Precision Computation
note: Tile-level GPGPU DSL for low-precision kernels; Ampere is a supported target. Concern: some tutorials target Blackwell-only features

title: ThunderGNN: Unlocking Tensor Cores for Graph Neural Networks
note: Sparsity-aware reordering and condensed storage to run GNN kernels on Tensor Cores; Ampere has Tensor Cores so this is reproducible on one A5000

title: ECHO: Efficient KV Cache Offloading with Lossless Prefetching for Serving Native Sparse Attention LLMs
note: KV-cache eviction/recall inside CUDA graphs + prefetching to host memory; mechanism is per-GPU. Concerns: artifact appendix asks for a server with 8 GPUs and ships as a Docker image (Docker is not installed here - would need porting); native-sparse-attention models must be picked small enough for 24 GB. Zenodo record: https://zenodo.org/records/20376436

title: Queue Management for SLO-Oriented Large Language Model Serving (QLM)
note: Request-group queue ordering plus an LP-backed virtual-queue model on top of vLLM - squarely an LLM serving / scheduling artifact. Concern - paper evaluates on heterogeneous multi-GPU setups (A100/A10G) and several models; scale-down to one 24 GB A5000 with a 7B model is straightforward but changes the SLO-attainment numbers. Python repo, actively pushed through 2025.

title: GTS: GPU-based Tree Index for Fast Similarity Search
note: GPU metric-space tree index for similarity search; the paper uses a single GPU so an A5000 fits. Concern: no official repo found via GitHub repo search or web search, so repo is unknown

title: DiFlow: A System for Micro-Serving Text-to-Image Diffusion Workflows
note: LegoDiffusion decomposes text-to-image diffusion workflows into independently scheduled model nodes. SD or FLUX class pipelines fit in 24 GB and the per-model sharing idea is testable on one GPU. Concerns: per-model scaling and adaptive model parallelism are cluster-scale claims that must be scaled down or simulated. No artifact link found.

title: Groundhog: Efficient Request Isolation in FaaS
note: In-memory process snapshot/restore between FaaS invocations built entirely in user space on fork plus Linux soft-dirty page tracking - the authors state it needs no changes to the OS kernel, language runtimes or functions. Concern - the end-to-end evaluation drives OpenWhisk with Docker containers, which is not installed and cannot be installed without root; the snapshot/restore mechanism itself can still be benchmarked standalone. Repo link is the Zenodo artifact record - no public GitHub mirror was found.

title: REFL: Resource-Efficient Federated Learning
note: Participant-selection and staleness-aware aggregation policies evaluated in a single-node FL simulator (FedScale lineage) - a pure user-space Python/PyTorch artifact. Concern - the paper's simulations use many worker processes and small vision/NLP models; client counts and model sizes will need scaling down to one A5000.

title: Partition, Don't Sort! Compression Boosters for Cloud Data Ingestion Pipelines
note: clustering-based compression booster for nested-data ingestion; CPU only

title: PowerInfer: Fast Large Language Model Serving with a Consumer-grade GPU
note: Designed for exactly this machine class: one consumer/workstation GPU plus CPU, hot/cold neuron-aware GPU-CPU hybrid inference with offloading. llama.cpp-based, user-space build, CUDA 11.8/12.x friendly, no root. 7B-13B models in the sparsity-aware formats fit 24 GB or spill to the 125 GiB host RAM by design. Strongest single candidate.

title: Tempo: Compiled Dynamic Deep Learning with Symbolic Dependence Graphs
note: Single-node DL compiler; the headline numbers (7x over JAX on Llama-3.2-3B decoding, 54x on RL algorithms with 16x lower peak memory) are all measured on one GPU and a 3B model fits comfortably in 24 GB. Compiler passes (tiling, fusion, polyhedral scheduling) are a rich improvement surface. Concerns - the polyhedral/codegen toolchain may need recent LLVM and CUDA installed per-user via conda.

title: Carbon-Aware Continuous Learning for Sustainable Real-Time Machine Learning Analytics
note: Carbon-aware scheduling of continuous retraining for edge ML analytics - retraining knobs and carbon traces can be studied on one GPU. Concerns: carbon intensity traces plus edge server assumptions, and no code found

title: How to Grow an LSM-tree? Towards Bridging the Gap Between Theory and Practice
note: LSM-tree growth scheme design and analysis with a prototype key-value store

title: Lobster: A GPU-Accelerated Framework for Neurosymbolic Programming
note: End-to-end GPU execution of a Datalog-based neurosymbolic language; user-space, single GPU

title: Learning-Augmented Heuristics: Simple Yet Smart, Robust and Interpretable Cache Eviction
note: Learned *parameters* for static eviction heuristics (S4-FIFO), with released code, pre-trained model, and libCacheSim + CacheLib implementations; evaluation is pure trace-driven simulation over thousands of public traces - perfect for a machine with no root. See also https://libcachesim.com and arXiv 2608.27975

title: Automated End-to-End Model Serving with Cooperative Compilation and Scheduling
note: Cooperative compilation and scheduling of multiple kernel variants for model serving - single-GPU compiler plus runtime contribution. No code found yet

title: Proteus: Preserving Model Confidentiality during Graph Optimizations
note: Partitions a DNN computation graph and hides subgraphs among generated decoys so a third party can still run compiler/graph optimizations - a user-space compiler artifact (artifact repo published, with a Dockerfile that can be read and reproduced via conda). Concern - the headline metric is confidentiality, not speed, so a performance hypothesis has to target obfuscation cost or preserved optimization quality; measuring the latter means running autotuning, which is GPU-hour heavy.

title: Subspace Collision: An Efficient and Accurate Framework for High-dimensional Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
note: Clustering-based ANN index framework; single machine

title: stratum: A System Infrastructure for Massive Agent-Centric ML Workloads
note: Vision paper proposing a runtime for executing thousands of agent-generated Python ML pipelines; artifact repo exists. Concern: vision-track paper so the prototype may be early stage

title: DroidSpeak: KV Cache Sharing Across Fine-tuned Model Variants
note: KV-cache reuse across different fine-tuned variants of the same architecture - a layer-sensitivity study plus selective recompute, and the paper itself measures Llama-3.1-8B on a single A100 so a single A5000 works. Concern - no artifact URL in the paper or on arXiv; authors are the LMCache group so code may live there, marked unknown.

title: Pea Hash: A Performant Extendible Adaptive Hashing Index
note: Extendible adaptive hash index trading latency against memory utilization; repo ships a DRAM-only variant. Concern: best results assume Optane PMEM and AVX-512 - the Zen3 Threadripper has neither, so expect a scaled-down baseline

title: MiniGraph: Querying Big Graphs with a Single Machine
note: Out-of-core graph processing engine explicitly designed for a single machine; C++ user space, disk-resident graphs fit 257 GB

title: XGrammar: Flexible and Efficient Structured Generation Engine for Large Language Models
note: Constrained-decoding engine - grammar compilation is CPU-side and overlapped with GPU decode, runs with any single-GPU serving backend - widely deployed so baselines are easy to get

title: Mitigating Resource Usage Dependency in Sorting-based KV Stores on Hybrid Storage Devices via Operation Decoupling
note: DecouKV decouples LSM flush/compaction operations to reduce write stalls on hybrid devices; artifact is RocksDB/MatrixKV/ADOC plus YCSB on a single server. Concern: the fast tier was Intel Optane DCPMM which is unavailable - would need NVMe-vs-SATA emulation

title: Apparate: Rethinking Early Exits to Tame Latency-Throughput Tensions in ML Serving
note: Early-exit ramps bolted onto existing serving systems; a pure user-space PyTorch/serving-runtime artifact. Models used (ResNet/BERT/GPT-2 class) fit one 24 GB A5000. Concern: paper evaluates on multi-GPU serving clusters, so a scale-down to one GPU plus a replay of their request traces is needed; goodput numbers will not be directly comparable.

title: FleetIO: Managing Multi-Tenant Cloud Storage with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
note: Multi-agent RL controller for multi-tenant SSD virtualization - learned policy plus trace-driven evaluation; concern: likely needs an SSD emulator and no official repo found by GitHub/web search

title: CAMEO: A Causal Transfer Learning Approach for Performance Optimization of Configurable Computer Systems
note: Causal-structure transfer learning for configuration tuning; the method is user-space Python and can be driven from the authors' offline configuration-measurement datasets. Concern: original target environments include NVIDIA Jetson TX1/TX2/Xavier hardware we do not have, so live-measurement experiments must be restricted to x86 or GPU workloads reproducible on the A5000.

title: DiffKV: Differentiated Memory Management for Large Language Models with Parallel KV Compaction
note: KV-cache compression plus an on-GPU allocator that compacts fragmented free lists in parallel; a vLLM-style single-GPU serving artifact and a very clean target for a "better allocator / better compression policy" hypothesis. Concerns - custom CUDA kernels may need a toolkit newer than the system nvcc 11.8 (installable per-user via conda, but driver 535 caps usable CUDA at 12.2).

title: ChameleonAPI: Automatic and Efficient Customization of Neural Networks for ML Applications
note: Application-aware retraining/customization of neural networks behind ML APIs - single-GPU training and inference of modest models no root needed

title: One Seed, Two Birds: A Unified Learned Structure for Exact and Approximate Counting
note: Unified learned structure serving both exact counting and cardinality estimation. Concern: no artifact found in GitHub search

title: FederatedScope: A Flexible Federated Learning Platform for Heterogeneity
note: Event-driven federated learning framework; the standard mode simulates many clients as processes on one node with one GPU

title: Voltrix: Sparse Matrix-Matrix Multiplication on Tensor Cores with Asynchronous and Balanced Kernel Optimization
note: Tensor-core SpMM kernel with asynchronous pipelining and load balancing; single-GPU CUDA kernel work, Ampere supports cp.async and FA2-style pipelining. Concern: evaluated on an 80 GB A100, so the larger graph datasets must be trimmed to 24 GB

title: GMorph: Accelerating Multi-DNN Inference via Model Fusion
note: Graph-mutation search that fuses several pre-trained task-specific DNNs into one multi-task model for cheaper inference. Models are CNN/small-transformer scale and inference is single-GPU. Concern - the search phase is expensive (repeated fine-tuning), so the search budget may have to be cut down

title: Push-Button Reliability Testing for Cloud-Backed Applications with Rainmaker
note: User-space REST fault-injection tool for cloud-backed applications needing no root kernel or hardware support - Concern: the .NET toolchain must be installed under HOME and reproducing the reported bugs needs cloud SDK targets or local emulators such as Azurite rather than real cloud accounts

title: High-Ratio Compression for Machine-Generated Data
note: High-ratio compression for machine-generated data inside storage engines; CPU only

title: Pravega: A Tiered Storage System for Data Streams
note: Tiered stream storage - hot append-only tier plus automatic migration to long-term object/file storage, with elastic per-stream segment scaling. Mature, fully open-source Java implementation with a documented single-process standalone mode; the tiering and auto-scaling policies are exactly the kind of user-space mechanism that can be re-designed and measured. Concerns - the paper evaluates a distributed deployment on AWS against Kafka and Pulsar, and the full stack pulls in Zookeeper plus Apache BookKeeper and an S3/NFS tier; a single-node scale-down (all three systems in one host, MinIO or local FS as tier 2) is plausible but needs to be validated early, and Java has to be installed through conda

title: BT-Tree: A Reinforcement Learning Based Index for Big Trajectory Data
note: Learned/RL-built index structure; CPU-only, user space

title: M2XFP: A Metadata-Augmented Microscaling Data Format for Efficient Low-bit Quantization
note: Metadata-augmented microscaling quantization; the released artifact is a pseudo-quantization and perplexity workflow on vLLM that fits one 24 GB GPU. Concern: the speedup claims rest on a hardware unit that cannot be built here

title: Controlling Opaque-Component Effects with Semisolates and Try
note: The paper explicitly states try is an *unprivileged*, language-agnostic command built on user namespaces / overlay mounts - bwrap-style sandboxing works on this machine. Clean single-machine performance target (effect capture/commit overhead)

title: Powering In-Database Dynamic Model Slicing for Structured Data Analytics
note: in-database dynamic model slicing shipped as a PostgreSQL extension in Rust

title: DiffServe: Efficiently Serving Text-to-Image Diffusion Models with Query-Aware Model Scaling
note: Diffusion-model serving with query-aware cascades - cascade and scheduling logic is user-space Python and SD-class models fit in 24 GB - concern: paper evaluates a multi-GPU serving cluster so a single-GPU scale-down changes the resource-allocation experiments

title: Eliminating Data Processing Bottlenecks in GNN Training over Large Graphs via Two-level Feature Compression
note: two-level feature compression plus GPU cache co-design for GNN training; single-GPU config available

title: Incr: Faster Re-Execution via Bolt-On Incrementalization
note: Automatic incrementalization of shell/polyglot re-execution - dependency tracking plus intermediate-result caching, all user space on one machine. Natural improvement axes (better caching policy, finer dependency granularity)

title: PreVision: An Out-of-Core Matrix Computation System with Optimal Buffer Replacement
note: Out-of-core matrix computation with an optimal buffer-replacement policy - a user-space caching/eviction problem on one node

title: Characterizing and Optimizing End-to-End Systems for Private Inference
note: End-to-end characterization and optimization of private-inference serving - client and server can be two processes on one host with one GPU; concern the contribution is partly cryptographic-protocol level

title: LogCloud: Fast Search of Compressed Logs on Object Storage
note: Compressed log storage plus an FM-index searchable directly from object storage. Concern: designed for S3 so a local MinIO or filesystem backend is needed to reproduce

title: Making In-Memory Learned Indexes Efficient on Disk
note: Makes in-memory learned indexes work on disk; single NVMe, user space

title: Reducing Cross-Cloud/Region Costs with the Auto-Configuring MACARON Cache
note: A cache sizing/admission policy paper - squarely in the caching topic - and the authors ship a separate trace-driven simulator (https://github.com/hojinp/macaron_simulator), which is the single-machine evaluation path env.md wants. Concern: the C++ prototype half was evaluated against real S3/cross-region storage; cost-model parameters would have to be taken from the paper rather than measured. Repos have no README or license metadata, so build effort is unverified from a desk check.

title: Dynamic Flat Filter: A Unified Framework for Scalable and Stable Fingerprint-Based Filters
note: framework that makes fingerprint filters (cuckoo/quotient) incrementally resizable - small storage data structure - concern: no repo located
